caption: 💌 SAVE this recipe so you have it ready for busy days. 🔄 SHARE with a mama who wants calm, toddler-approved snacks. These Pear & Fig Protein Brownies prove that real food can taste like dessert 👌 soft, rich, and toddler-approved. 🍐✨ Made with red beans for gentle protein, pear for natural sweetness, and figs for fiber & calm energy. No refined sugar, no flour chaos ... just slow, steady fuel for little tummies. 👩‍🍳 Recipe (12×18 cm pan) • ½ cup (90 g) cooked red beans, rinsed • 1 ripe pear (≈100 g) • 2 tbsp unsweetened cacao • 1 egg • 1/4 cup spelt flour (≈40 g) • 1 tbsp neutral oil • 1 tbsp honey or maple syrup • 1/2 tsp vanilla extract  • 2–3 dried figs, soaked 10–15 min then chopped Method: 1️⃣ Blend red beans with pear until completely smooth. 2️⃣ Add cacao, egg, flour, oil, and honey ⏭️ mix again until creamy. 3️⃣ Pour into a lined 12×18 cm pan, stir in the chopped figs and bake at 180°C for 20–25 min, until set but still soft. They stay moist for 3 days airtight, or 1 month frozen. Snack time isn’t control anymore, it’s connection. 💛 #toddlersnack #healthytoddlersnacks #realfoodmom #calmkitchen #naturalsweetness
